links.outcome: Exact-match agreement with specialist consensus, LLMs versus residents on same cases
links.effect: Exact-match to five-specialist consensus was 42.2% for residents versus 59.4–75.0% for LLMs; LLM–specialist ICC 0.61–0.65.
links.quote: Exact-match to a five-specialist consensus was 42.2% for residents versus 59.4–75.0% for LLMs; classifications outside the range of ratings assigned by individual specialists were rare (0–3.1%).

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM performance on ASA-PS classification against clinician consensus on retrospective/anonymized cases without testing a specific deployment safeguard or operational practice.
